capacity_per_week.label: Capacity per week
capacity_per_week.notes: None = ∞ (manuscript). Finite required for capacity_reduction events and P-S.3.

tier.label: Tier
tier.notes: Reserved extension point; v1 simulates tier 1 only.

initial_on_hand.label: Initial on hand
initial_on_hand.notes: None → warm start at t=0: on hand = S_m − E[D_m]·T_s = E[D_m]·κ + safety stock, pipeline primed so position = S_m.

demand_mode.label: Demand mode
demand_mode.notes: b_p — historical median; the average (mode) of the triangularAV demand form.

demand_floor_factor.label: Demand floor factor
demand_floor_factor.notes: ν override; falls back to the global setting. Acts as the variability of the triangularAV demand form: triangular(b·(1−ν), b, b·(1+ν)).

demand_cv.label: Demand CV
demand_cv.notes: Coefficient of variation for demand_model=normal: σ = cv · demand_mode. Negative draws are set to 0 and counted (ADR 0002, decision 8). Read only by normal; triangular uses demand_floor_factor / explicit bounds.

fg_policy.label: FG policy
fg_policy.notes: base_stock (S) · min_max (s, S) · days_of_cover (D). MTS only.

fg_base_stock.label: FG base stock
fg_base_stock.notes: S^FG_p: the order-up-to level (base_stock, min_max); derived if None under base_stock. MTS only.

fg_reorder_point.label: FG reorder point
fg_reorder_point.notes: s: min_max only — produce up to S when the stock left after this week's demand falls below s.

fg_cover_days.label: FG cover days
fg_cover_days.notes: D: days_of_cover only — target = D/7 × projected weekly demand; moves with the forecast.

fg_initial_on_hand.label: FG initial on hand
fg_initial_on_hand.notes: FG opening stock (engine RFC 4). None = start at the policy target.

lead_time_dist.label: Lead time dist
lead_time_dist.notes: Stochastic lead times are pre-drawn per (link, week) from the world leadtime stream, so CRN pairing holds across policies (docs/statistics.md).

primary.label: Primary
primary.notes: Chosen primary source for its material (the /policies Supplier stage). False everywhere → the manuscript rule: min cost, then lead time, then id.

sla_fill_floor_pct.label: SLA fill floor pct
sla_fill_floor_pct.notes: Default per-row service target under sla_tier; None = the segment floor.

demand_model.label: Demand model
demand_model.notes: deterministic | normal | triangular | triangular_av | poisson. None = the product's distribution scaled by share.

demand_mean.label: Demand mean
demand_mean.notes: The row's mean (the mode for triangular). Past the end of a forecast it is the value the plan uses.

demand_variation.label: Demand variation
demand_variation.notes: Interpreted by model: normal → coefficient of variation (σ = cv · centre); triangular_av → ± fraction of the centre; ignored by deterministic, poisson and triangular (whose bounds are explicit).

unit_price.label: Unit price
unit_price.notes: The row's sell price; None = the product's unit_price.

forecast.label: Forecast
forecast.notes: One value per simulated week from week 0: the centre of that week's distribution, and what the plan reads. Past its end the row uses demand_mean if set, else the last value (with a warning).

lead_time_weeks.label: Lead time weeks
lead_time_weeks.notes: T_E transit leg, added to the supplier link's lead time at compile; 0 = behavior-neutral.

warmup_method.label: Warmup method
warmup_method.notes: Runs Conway and MSER-5, adopts the later week.

warmup_end.label: Warmup end
warmup_end.notes: t_w. Required when warmup_method=manual; auto-detected otherwise. Manuscript: 85.

project_seed.label: Project seed
project_seed.notes: Root of the SeedSequence tree (Part VIII).

model_seeds.label: Model seeds
model_seeds.notes: Replications over world streams. Study-grade floor is 30 (Part VIII); results below 10 carry a below_replication_floor badge.

disruption_event_seeds.label: Disruption event seeds
disruption_event_seeds.notes: (start, duration, magnitude) draws. Collapses to 1 when all events are fixed.

crn_enabled.label: CRN enabled
crn_enabled.notes: Common random numbers; required for synergy math.

bootstrap_resamples.label: Bootstrap resamples
bootstrap_resamples.notes: Percentile bootstrap on Δ and synergy metrics.

replication_stopping.label: Replication stopping
replication_stopping.notes: sequential_ci stops when FR CI half-width ≤ ε.

run_mode.label: Run mode
run_mode.notes: fast_scan: 10×6 seeds, kpi_only traces, wide-CI badge (Part X). Never silently mixed with full-mode results.

detection_lag_weeks.label: Detection lag weeks
detection_lag_weeks.notes: Delay between physical disruption start and firm knowledge (PH-20). Manuscript core uses 0; P-S.4 early_warning_failover governs this lever.

trace_verbosity.label: Trace verbosity
trace_verbosity.notes: Stress tests default to kpi_only (≈100× less IO).

start.label: Start
start.notes: t*. None → auto: U{t_w .. t_w+2} (steady state) from the hazard_start stream.

duration.label: Duration
duration.notes: Δt. int = fixed; range = U{min..max} from the hazard_duration stream.

policies.name: inventory_control
policies.summary: Everyday replenishment rule (min-max / base-stock / (R,Q) / periodic). The baseline shock absorber every chain already has; quantifying it prevents over-buying dedicated resilience.

params.label: Policy type
params.notes: min_max ✅ (manuscript). mrp: BOM × planned production over the lead time, net of stock and the pipeline (WP 14.5).

params.label: Basis
params.notes: Policy Basis (§II.4): days_of_supply sizes levels from the stationary mean (s = E[D_m]·T_s); forward_visible sums the committed forward order book over the coverage window (WSC-2026 MTO) — requires the P-C.6 forward_visibility customer policy.

params.label: Material overrides
params.notes: material_id → row-level override from the supplier grid (§II.3). Unknown material ids are ignored at runtime.

policies.name: safety_stock_materials
policies.summary: ABC-XYZ-differentiated material safety stock (Eqs. 20–21). Dominates short disruptions; depletes — beyond ~7–9 weeks expediting wins (run the crossover sweep).

params.label: ABC breakpoints
params.notes: A up to 80%, B up to 95%, C the rest (80/15/5).

params.label: Fixed days by material
params.notes: Per-material fixed-days cover (the /policies Supplier stage's safety-stock days). A listed material's buffer is E[D_m]·days/7 whatever the classification; unlisted materials follow it.

policies.name: unmet_demand_handling
policies.summary: What happens to an unservable order: it dies (lost_sales — competitive markets), waits (backorder — contractual B2B), or splits (partial_backorder). Backorders convert lost revenue into delay cost, changing the economics of every strategy.

params.label: Partial accept prob
params.notes: Share of unmet demand that waits.

policies.name: customer_allocation
policies.summary: Under scarcity, 'who do we disappoint first' is deliberate — protect strategic accounts / SLA tiers / spread pain. Inert for single-customer MTO. Hook: PH-60.

params.label: Rule
params.notes: fcfs/proportional/fair_share coincide at weekly buckets (pro-rata); priority, sla_tier and revenue_max (by row price) reorder.

params.label: SLA tiers
params.notes: Guaranteed first-pass fill per segment; scaled down pro-rata when supply cannot honor all floors.

params.label: C2::p2
params.notes: '<customer>::<product>' → priority; beats priority_weights and Customer.priority_weight for that row.

params.label: Row price
params.notes: '<customer>::<product>' → price revenue_max orders by; beats the row's own unit price.

params.label: Row floor pct
params.notes: '<customer>::<product>' → the row's service target under sla_tier; beats Customer.sla_fill_floor_pct and sla_tiers.
